capabilityName: Method of Manufactured Solutions (MMS) + ASME V&V 20-2009 Grid Convergence Index (GCI)
verificationStandard: ASME V&V 20-2009 (Standard for Verification and Validation in Computational Fluid Dynamics and Heat Transfer) & Roache (1994, 1998)

implementationFiles.role: Production ASME V&V 20 MMS verification and BVP solver engine
Legacy MMS discrete stencil verifier (backward compatibility)

testFiles.role: Phase 2 Red-Team Adversarial Test Suite for CAP-SUP-003

independentOracle.role: Decoupled analytical mathematics oracle providing exact calculus solutions, integrals, and independent ASME V&V 20 equations
independentOracle.independenceDeclaration: The IndependentMmsOracle contains zero imports or references to production solvers, matrix algebra classes, or discrete mesh structures.

benchmark2D.exactSolution: u(x, y) = sin(pi * x) * sin(pi * y)

negativeTests.description: Mesh refinement ratio r < 1.10 violating ASME V&V 20 guidelines
negativeTests.expectedResult: REJECTED with explicit ratio violation explanation

negativeTests.description: Grid sequence exhibiting monotonic or oscillatory divergence (R >= 1.0 or R <= -1.0)
Dirichlet boundary values mismatched against analytical manufactured solution
negativeTests.expectedResult: REJECTED with boundary error mismatch alert

negativeTests.description: Source term mathematically inconsistent with governing differential operator
negativeTests.expectedResult: REJECTED due to scheme non-convergence to exact solution

negativeTests.description: Non-uniformly distorted node spacing without metric transformation
negativeTests.expectedResult: REJECTED due to degraded convergence order or broken asymptotic range

negativeTests.description: Algebraic solver instability causing divergent state (NaN or Infinity)
Solver iterations artificially truncated before algebraic convergence
negativeTests.expectedResult: REJECTED due to high algebraic residual contaminating discretization error

negativeTests.description: Spatial discretization stencil degraded to 1st-order upwind
negativeTests.expectedResult: REJECTED because observed order p ~ 1.0 fails 2nd-order contract

unknownUnknownFindings.finding: Euler-Maclaurin composite integration super-convergence masking low-order spatial discretization errors when evaluating symmetric domain integrals
unknownUnknownFindings.mitigation: Dual verification enforced: local pointwise Quantity of Interest and discrete L2 field norms must both independently confirm observed order within 0.15 of theoretical order.

limitations: ASME V&V 20 GCI calculation requires minimum 3 systematically refined grid levels (r >= 1.10).
Richardson extrapolation assumes solution is in the asymptotic convergence regime (0.90 <= Ar <= 1.10).
Non-linear shocks or geometric singularities with order degradation require local adaptive mesh refinement (AMR) not covered in uniform BVP benchmarks.
